title: Ro kar sakina kahete thi zindane sham me
body:
Ro kar sakina kahete thi zindane sham me
Amma kab hogi roshnai zindane sham me
Allah kaisa ghaazab ka Andhra muqam hai
Kaise baser ho zindagi zindane sham me
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahete thi maa khareb hai waqte shear na ro
Ayege roshni aabhi zindane sham me
Aai shumr khol de zara gardan ki resma
Rukte hai sans bachi ki zindane sham me
<<DIVIDER>>
Kurta jalaa sakina ka gouhaar bhi chingaye
Mara shumr tamache bhi zindane sham me
Bhega yazid khane mein rakhkar sare hussain
Pahla Gaya hussain ka zindane sham me
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekhe behen ki nafs tu rone lage imam
Mazhar sakina margaye zindane sham me
